Answer: C
Reason: Visual inspection confirms complete opacification (whiteout) of the left hemithorax with contralateral mediastinal shift to the right, which is the classic radiographic sign of a massive space-occupying lesion like pleural effusion or empyema (guided by t000002). The report generator's description of "bibasilar opacities" and "small effusions" significantly underestimates the severity seen in the pixels, necessitating reliance on direct visual verification over the automated text.
